category.description: Task category mapped to GRAEAE task_type. Default: 'general'. Common values: reasoning, architecture_design, code_generation, web_search.

mode.description: Consultation mode. Default: 'auto'. Supported: auto, single, debate, majority, all, local, external.

muses.description: Optional list of provider names to consult (e.g. ['claude', 'openai', 'gemini']). When set, only those providers are queried. When omitted, the engine uses its default auto lineup.

prompt.description: The consultation prompt or question to submit.
